body:
sara (support): heads up — ACME just escalated. They say during yesterday's spike their audit logs were incomplete and a subset of requests showed auth failures (401) followed by timeouts (503). They're asking for ISO27001 mapping proof for data retention and KMS/HSM handling. They want a reproduction for billing dispute too. :grimacing:

mike (eng-sre): ack. can you paste the repro steps + sample trace ids? also what model/endpoint and region?

sara (support): yes — region=us-west-2, model=redwood-2-small, route=/v1/generate. Repro steps below:
```
# repro (customer)
1) GET /v1/models -> ok
2) POST /v1/generate with api_key X -> responds 401 for some tokens
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted-customer-key>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-2-small","input":"short"}'
# when it fails we see 401 then subsequent attempts show high latency (20s) and 503
```
Logs (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-12T21:04:05Z] trace=tr_0a1b2c auth=fail code=401 user=cust-203 shard=gpu-pool-4
[2026-03-12T21:04:18Z] trace=tr_0a1b2c route=/v1/generate latency=20345ms code=503 backend=kv-cache
[2026-03-12T21:05:01Z] trace=tr_0a1b2d bill_event=double_charge invoice=inv_994
```

jules (compliance): tagging ISO items — for audit logs and retention we map to Annex A controls along lines of A.12.4 (logging), A.8.2 (asset handling), A.18.1 (compliance). We need to know:
- retention period customer expects vs our default (what is ACME requesting?)
- are the missing entries deleted/never emitted or truncated due to retention policy?
- which KMS key protected the logs/encryption at time=2026-03-12T21:04Z? HSM involvement?

sara (support): ACME says they expect 7 years (contract says 5). They flagged missing entries for a 30m window. KMS key id in logs appears as key:kms-prod-17. HSM vendor = nCipher (customer asked specifically about HSM-backed wrapping).

aaron (security): :eyes: can we confirm key:kms-prod-17 is HSM-backed (wrapped by nCipher HSM) or a software key in KMS? If it was rotated around that time we might see gaps during rotation. Also need to rule out prefix/KV-cache eviction causing logs to show 503s.

mike (eng-sre): checking rotation logs now. quick snippet from keystore audit: `rotate start 2026-03-12T20:59:50Z key=kms-prod-17 status=rolling` — there was a short period where shards were rekeying. That could correlate. I'll pull matching node/gpu logs for that epoch.

sara (support): customer also has a billing claim: they were charged twice for two requests (see invoice inv_994). They provided a trace for double-charge above. They want a formal repro and a note for ISO audit showing root cause + mitigation.

jules (compliance): for the ISO mapping doc we need: incident timeline, artifact locations (S3 bucket names, audit-log index names), proof of key lifecycle (rotation timestamps, KMS/HSM attestations), retention policy config, and customer-facing statement templates. I can draft the mapping once we confirm artifacts.

mike (eng-sre): found node logs showing `kv-cache eviction` and `replay gap` during key rotation window. Potential sequence: 1) key rotation triggered cache flush 2) some in-flight requests failed auth (401) while token verification retried 3) fallback caused increased latency and 503s 4) billing duplication due to retry logic on client side + server accepted second attempt. I'll attach a short log excerpt to the incident.

aaron (security): action items:
- Confirm HSM wrap for kms-prod-17 with infra/KMS team (whoami: @aaron)
- Produce signed attestations for rotation event (vendor proof)
- Check retention config: confirm default=5y and contract override for ACME = 7y (if mismatch, prod change needed)
- Anti-duplication: verify idempotency token handling for /v1/generate (we should reject duplicates within Xs)

sara (support): I'll ask ACME for their exact idempotency header (if any) and their timeline. Also sending a short apology + follow-up ETA.

ops-bot: Incident created #INC-2026-1487 -> assigned to eng-sre, security, and compliance. ETA for initial RCA 24h. :white_check_mark:

jules (compliance): please collect these artifacts into a single zip (redact PII) and upload to https://redwood.share/internal/iso27001-mappings/ACME-INC-2026-1487. I'll start the ISO control mapping doc and mark open items.

mike (eng-sre): noted. immediate repro: I can reproduce 401 -> 503 locally by forcing key rotation script on staging and running the customer's sequence. I'll capture packet traces, logs, and reproduce billing dup using a test client that retries without idempotency.

sara (support): thanks — I'll keep ACME updated. tagging @aaron @jules for visibility.

mike (eng-sre): will post RCA draft and artifacts in the incident thread when ready.

sara (support): closing loop for now. if you need me to push a hotfix (idempotency guard) tell me and i'll create the release PR. :+1:
